identification: Pro Hart (Kevin Charles Hart) small hand-coloured line etching from the Lytlewode Press Waltzing Matilda series (swagman and jumbuck at a billabong, plate signed PRO HART, 127 x 147 mm, edition 100). Certificate from Robert Littlewood reads Series 1 No. 30 'His Ghost May Be Heard', unsigned publisher's proof, so it may belong to a different print. Pencil mark in margin is faint, not a clear signature. Framed, clean.

viewing_check: Look for a pencil signature and edition number in the sheet margin (photograph it), and whether the plate image matches the title on the certificate (His Ghost May Be Heard). Check the plate for PRO HART and date, and whether the print is a coloured line etching and not a reproduction. Check back of frame for any title label.
